title: Coordination, Review & Sign-Off

requirements.statement: Coordination activities shall be organized around distinct coordination stages or gates aligned to delivery milestones defined under S2.
All models subject to coordination shall be federated in a common, verified coordinate system before coordination checks are performed.
Coordination checks shall use defined check types, priorities, and tolerances documented in the project ruleset.
Coordination issues shall be uniquely identified, classified by priority and type, assigned to an identifiable responsible party, and tracked through a governed status progression.
A coordination sign-off shall be recorded at each governed coordination gate.
The Project BIM Manager, or delegated role per project RACI, shall hold approval authority for coordination sign-off.
Coordination check results, issue logs, and sign-off records shall be maintained as auditable evidence.
Unresolved coordination issues that cannot be resolved within the coordination cycle shall follow a defined escalation route.

implementation_boundary: This L4 standard is tool-agnostic. ACC, Navisworks, folder paths, export presets, and numeric project tolerances are implementation/project rules and are not elevated into enterprise doctrine.
